question: A project lead needs Claude to work across a very large set of meeting notes inside one conversation on her paid plan. Which choice best supports that?
options: A) Choose the fastest and cheapest model available, because lighter models are given more room for long inputs.
B) Choose whichever model she used last, because the context window is identical across every available model.
C) Choose a previous-generation model, because older models were given more room before the newer releases.
D) Choose one of the newest flagship models, which offer the largest context window for chatting on paid plans.
correct_answers: D) Choose one of the newest flagship models, which offer the largest context window for chatting on paid plans.
explanations: Incorrect. The fastest, cheapest tier is not the one with the largest window; speed and window size are separate trade-offs.
Incorrect. Window size varies by model, so the choice of model directly changes how much a single chat can hold.
Incorrect. The newest flagship models offer the largest windows; earlier models are more limited, not less.
Correct. The newest flagship models provide a one-million-token window when chatting on any paid plan, which is the most room available for a single conversation.
